$comment: Always-visible declarations for Weft's own shipped surfaces (decisions 2, 8, 11 — AC9). Quiet is the default; a surface shipping an always-visible field names why, from the five sanctioned reasons in tooling/visibility-reasons.js. The gate validates DECLARATION — whether a reason is honest is a design-review judgement no test can make, recorded in doctrine. Heddle declares its own panel surfaces in its own repository; the shared list is the only cross-repository artifact.

surfaces.note: The weft-board rail — the argument on the record from decision 2: its filters are touched more than once per visit (frequent), only useful read together (comparative), and typing changes the board already on screen (live).
The measured reference page: displaying the input surface is the page's whole job.
The component gallery: displaying the primitives is the page's whole job.
The self-contained rendered reference: displaying the documented system, inputs included, is the page's whole job.
